title: FR NIS2 Transposition 2024 — section 3
text:
LAW CONTEXT — CRITICAL NOTE:
- Loi 2024-449 is PARTIAL NIS2 transposition only. It covers:
    Title I: Critical infrastructure resilience (operators of vital importance - OIV)
    Title II: Electronic communications security
    Partial cybersecurity provisions
- The FULL NIS2 transposition for remaining entities (essential/important operators under
  Directive 2022/2555) requires a separate "Projet de loi Résilience" (PJL Résilience)
  which as of April 2026 is still in parliamentary process.
- ANSSI (cyber.gouv.fr) as of March 2026 still refers to "article 14 du projet de loi
  Résilience" for the cybersecurity framework (ReCyF). This confirms full transposition
  is incomplete as of the date this file was created.

RETRIEVAL INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Browser access: https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/id/JORFTEXT000049502615
2. DILA open data: curl https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/JORF/Freemium_jorf_global_20250713-140000.tar.gz
   then extract JORFTEXT000049502615.xml from the archive
3. Signed PDF: available at Legifrance via browser download (authenticated JORF PDF)
